title: API Atlas catalog row
description: One resource in the API Atlas catalog. Mirrors data/catalog.jsonl (one object per line), data/catalog.json (array) and the Markdown tables under catalog/. The Markdown is the source of truth; these fields are generated from it.

id.description: Stable identifier: the resource host without www plus the slugified name, e.g. open-meteo.com/open-meteo.

name.description: Display name, as written in the Markdown name cell.

type.description: API: a callable service. Dataset: a downloadable or queryable data collection. Portal: a catalog of datasets. MCP: a Model Context Protocol server.

category.description: Category slug, matching one file under catalog/.

description.description: One factual sentence. No marketing language, no trailing period.

docs.description: Official documentation page, or null when none is recorded.

access.description: Cheapest usable tier as stated by the provider. '-' means not established, never 'probably free'.

auth.description: What is needed before the first request.

license.description: Licence or terms the provider states, as text or a Markdown link. '-' when none is established.

source.description: Where the row came from: editorial, public-apis, APIs.guru, awesome-datasets, or a comma separated combination.

checked.description: Date a person last read the official documentation and confirmed the row, or null when nobody has.

verified.description: Derived: true when checked is not null. Says a human confirmed the row at least once, not that it is current.

docs_present.description: Derived: true when a documentation URL is recorded.

license_known.description: Derived: true when a licence or terms value is recorded.
